concerns.text: FR-001 in the spec requires filtering ONLY rows where `diffusion_mode == "self"`. The plan’s “Key Amendment” revises FR-001 to also require extraction of FCC solute‑diffusion rows, which is not reflected in the specification. This over‑reaches the spec and creates a mismatch; either the spec must be amended to include the solute‑diffusion requirement, or the plan must be reverted to match the original FR‑001.
